root_cause: torch.load(map_location=trainer.device) moved non-capturable AdamW step counters from CPU to CUDA. Optimizer.load_state_dict retains step location; GPU state equality gate correctly rejected it.
repair: Deserialize checkpoint on CPU; module/optimizer.load_state_dict place parameters/moments according to their device policy. Preserve CPU AdamW step; retain exact device checks.
regression: CPU/CUDA AdamW and SGD save/load replay compares next update, optimizer values/devices, CPU/CUDA RNG exactly.
dispatch_repair: Seven independent family gates; each gate enables only its full validation. A failure blocks descendants of that family, not other methods. Explicit failure/blocked state; no indefinite WAIT on a failed upstream.
